rules.join: a topic covers a section when the section falls in one of the topic's sections entries, ranges expanded end to end
rules.sort: rows in section order; slugs sorted ascending
rules.coverageThresholdNote: No record is dropped for covering too much. Smyth's own index headwords carry book-sized ranges (Verbs covers 1,026 sections, Syntax 542), and on those sections the slug says little that the section's own path does not; but every threshold that removes them also strips hundreds of sections of every topic they have, and picking one would be the hand-built ontology SPEC-topics.md refuses. broadestTopics below lets a renderer rank or filter.
